source.enumeration_basis: Every line of source/codigo-penal-1940.txt that opens an article ('Art. N', 'Art N', 'Art. N-X', 'Art. N-X-Y', revoked ones included), restricted to this part: Parte Geral Título V Caps. I–III, arts. 32–76 (espécies, cominação e aplicação da pena, concurso de crimes, limite). Generated mechanically by the conductor; units are articles.
source.enumeration_note: ONE PART (g1b) of twelve; registers/merge-parts.py merges them into registers/encoding-roadmap.json, whose enumeration is complete (434 units, every article number 1–361).
